import Foundation

func work(_ item: Int) async {}
func save(_ item: Int) async throws {}
func log(_ item: Int) async {}

@MainActor final class VM {
  var items: [Int] = []
  var tasks: [Int: Task<Void, Never>] = [:]

  // CASE attr_capture expect=pass
  func a() {
    for item in items {
      Task { @MainActor [weak self] in
        await self?.go(item)
      }
    }
  }

  // CASE detached_capture expect=pass
  func b() {
    for item in items {
      Task.detached { [weak self] in
        await self?.go(item)
      }
    }
  }

  // CASE capture_sig expect=pass
  func c() {
    for item in items {
      Task { [weak self] () async -> Void in
        await self?.go(item)
      }
    }
  }

  // CASE underscore_assign expect=pass
  func d() {
    for item in items {
      _ = Task { await work(item) }
    }
  }

  // CASE dict_store expect=pass
  func e() {
    for item in items {
      tasks[item] = Task(priority: .high) { [weak self] in
        await self?.go(item)
      }
    }
  }

  // CASE let_generic_noargs expect=pass
  func f() {
    for item in items {
      let t = Task<Void, Never> { await work(item) }
      tasks[item] = t
    }
  }

  // CASE generic_detached expect=pass
  func g() {
    for item in items {
      tasks[item] = Task<Void, Never>.detached { await work(item) }
    }
  }

  // CASE if_inside expect=pass
  func h(flag: Bool) {
    for item in items {
      if flag {
        Task { await work(item) }
      }
    }
  }

  // CASE dispatch_nested expect=pass
  func i() {
    for item in items {
      DispatchQueue.main.async {
        Task { await work(item) }
      }
    }
  }

  // CASE sibling_after_task expect=fire
  func j() async {
    for item in items {
      Task { await log(item) }
      await work(item)
    }
  }

  // CASE value_await expect=fire
  func k() async {
    for item in items {
      let t = Task { await work(item) }
      await t.value
    }
  }

  // CASE value_inline_generic expect=fire
  func l() async {
    for item in items {
      await Task<Void, Never> { await work(item) }.value
    }
  }

  // CASE yield_await expect=fire
  func m() async {
    for item in items {
      Task { await work(item) }
      await Task.yield()
    }
  }

  // CASE init_explicit expect=pass
  func n() {
    for item in items {
      Task.init { await work(item) }
    }
  }

  // CASE awaited_arg_generic expect=fire
  func o() async {
    for item in items {
      Task<Void, Never>(priority: await pickPriority()) { await work(item) }
    }
  }

  // CASE nested_loop_in_generic expect=fire
  func p(groups: [[Int]]) {
    for group in groups {
      Task<Void, Never> {
        for item in group {
          await work(item)
        }
      }
    }
  }

  // CASE group_join_per_batch expect=fire
  func q(batches: [[Int]]) async {
    for batch in batches {
      await withTaskGroup(of: Void.self) { group in
        for item in batch {
          group.addTask { await work(item) }
        }
      }
    }
  }

  // CASE group_window expect=fire
  func r() async {
    await withTaskGroup(of: Void.self) { group in
      var running = 0
      for item in items {
        if running >= 4 {
          await group.next()
          running -= 1
        }
        group.addTask { await work(item) }
        running += 1
      }
    }
  }

  // CASE group_operation_label expect=pass
  func s() async {
    await withTaskGroup(of: Void.self) { group in
      for item in items {
        group.addTask(operation: { await work(item) })
      }
    }
  }

  // CASE group_capture_priority expect=pass
  func t() async {
    await withTaskGroup(of: Void.self) { group in
      for item in items {
        group.addTask(priority: .low) { [weak self] in
          await self?.go(item)
        }
      }
    }
  }

  // CASE throwing_group_unless expect=pass
  func u() async throws {
    try await withThrowingTaskGroup(of: Void.self) { group in
      for item in items {
        _ = group.addTaskUnlessCancelled { try await save(item) }
      }
      try await group.waitForAll()
    }
  }

  // CASE group_next_in_loop expect=fire
  func v() async {
    await withTaskGroup(of: Int.self) { group in
      for item in items {
        group.addTask {
          await work(item)
          return item
        }
        _ = await group.next()
      }
    }
  }

  // CASE while_let_task expect=pass
  func w(queue: [Int]) {
    var q = queue
    while let item = q.popLast() {
      Task { [item] in await work(item) }
    }
  }

  // CASE nested_closure_await_outside expect=fire
  func x() async {
    for item in items {
      Task { await work(item) }
      try? await save(item)
    }
  }

  func go(_ item: Int) async {}
  func pickPriority() async -> TaskPriority { .low }
}
